headline: Colombia DNP Notes 64% of Municipalities Face Fiscal Risk in 2025 Review
summary: Colombia's DNP reported that 706 municipalities (64%) remain at risk or deteriorated fiscally, despite overall national improvement. Girardota, Betulia, and El Retiro ranked highest in fiscal performance.
why: Sub-sovereign fiscal performance influences local credit conditions, national transfer budgets, and Colombia's broader sovereign balance sheet.
